newsitem.title: CHINA: Eleven dead, 97 injured in China cinema bombing.
newsitem.headline: Eleven dead, 97 injured in China cinema bombing.

text.p: Eleven people were killed and more than 97 others injured when a bomb exploded in a cinema in southwestern China's Sichuan province, according to a report made available in Beijing on Sunday.
The explosion in a cinema in Santai county seriously injured 37 and slightly injured more than 60, said the September 26 edition of the Sichuan Daily.
"According to initial police judgements, this was a case of an intentional bombing," the newspaper said.
The case was under investigation, it said but gave no further details.
